text: The 'Debris and Sediment Clearance and Cultural Asset Restoration (Budget 2024)' initiative is a recovery-focused effort by the New Zealand Government, under the Department of Conservation, to address weather-related damage to public conservation lands and waters, and to protect historic and cultural heritage. It involves clearing debris and sediment, repairing damaged conservation assets, and safeguarding cultural heritage sites affected by the 2023 North Island weather events, including Cyclone Gabrielle.
